title: WritePixelRegion
description: One rectangle of RGBA8 samples written into the image a layer's pixels or mask show, at (x, y) of that image. A rectangle that already holds the samples is `mutation.no-op`, a missing layer or image is `mutation.target-missing`, a locked layer or a layer without pixels is `mutation.target-mismatch`, a rectangle outside the image or a wrong sample count is `mutation.invariant`.

description.en: The layer whose image is written.
description.de: Die Ebene, deren Bild geschrieben wird.

samples.description: width x height RGBA8 samples, row-major.
